name: Admission Suitability
purpose: Determine whether requested services and risks can be safely supported

name: Level of Care & Care Complexity
purpose: Determine care level from structured assessment and clinical validation

name: Change in Condition
purpose: Determine appropriate response to a resident change in condition

name: Fall Response
purpose: Determine immediate response, escalation and post-fall pathway

name: Clinical Escalation
purpose: Determine routine vs urgent vs emergency escalation

name: Medication Variance
purpose: Determine response to medication error/variance/adverse event

name: Safeguarding
purpose: Determine protection, reporting and escalation for suspected abuse/neglect/exploitation

name: Infection / Outbreak
purpose: Determine precautions, escalation and outbreak response

name: Hospital Transfer
purpose: Determine whether transfer is required and manage handoff/return

name: Care Task Exception
purpose: Determine response to missed/refused/unsafe/uncompleted care task

name: Care Level Change
purpose: Determine when reassessment and level-of-care change are required

name: Dedicated Staffing / Private Caregiver Determination
purpose: Determine whether resident needs can be met within final LOC shared staffing or require incremental dedicated 1:1 staffing

name: Additional Clinical & Skilled Services Determination
purpose: Determine whether a change-of-condition intervention is included LOC nursing oversight, separately chargeable skilled/ancillary service, recurring package need, or capability escalation
